nodes.prompt:
TASK: Audit Ferryx frontend worktree/tab/session persistence for the reported cross-worktree leakage and restart-loss bug; return a root-cause candidate with exact file:line references and a minimal RED test target.
DELIVERABLE: A concise report containing (1) current storage key and serialization/restore flow, (2) whether state is keyed by project, worktree, or a shared global, (3) exact likely fault mechanism, (4) specific test name/file that should fail before a fix, and (5) source files likely needing a change.
SCOPE: Read only ui/src/lib/sessionPersistence.ts, ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts, ui/src/App.tsx, ui/src/lib/storageKeys.ts, their directly imported workspace-state helpers, and related tests. Do not edit files, run Git writes, or inspect unrelated current working-tree changes.
VERIFY: Cite exact source locations and run no mutations; state whether the flow can be demonstrated with the existing unit tests.
STOP WHEN: You return the five-part report with exact path:line evidence.
